options.name: baseUrl
options.description: another address only for tests and a local stack; the SDK adds /api

options.name: timeout
options.description: seconds one attempt may take; more than zero

options.name: connectTimeout
options.description: seconds the connection may take to open; more than zero

options.name: retries
options.description: attempts after the first one, on no answer, 429 and 503; zero or more

options.name: logger
options.description: the journal of the SDK; silent unless given

options.name: spanRecorder
options.description: where the spans of runs go; nowhere unless given

options.name: httpClient
options.description: a PSR-18 client, used as it is with its own timeouts; discovered when null

options.name: requestFactory
options.description: a PSR-17 request factory; discovered when null

options.name: streamFactory
options.description: a PSR-17 stream factory; discovered when null

options.name: webhookSecret
options.description: the signing secret of the webhook endpoint; empty is none

options.name: webhookToleranceSeconds
options.description: how far the time of a webhook signature may be from now; 1 or more
